ASSET SET: Realistic procedural trees/bushes generated with EZ-Tree (headless) - Duel Academy Island
AUTHOR: Daniel Greenheck (EZ-Tree generator and leaf textures); bark: Poly Haven (bark_brown_02, bark_willow_02), TextureCan (#588)
LICENSE: MIT (EZ-Tree code + bundled leaf textures; keep generator/LICENSE_ez-tree_MIT.txt) + CC0 1.0 (bark textures)
SOURCE PAGE: https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree (npm @dgreenheck/ez-tree 1.1.0)
CATEGORY: vegetation
  SM_BroadTree_A_ez.gltf      -> SM_BroadTree_A  round-canopy broadleaf, 12 m, 24,230 tris (oak leaves)
  SM_BroadTree_A_ash_ez.gltf  -> SM_BroadTree_A  alt: same shape family with pinnate "ash" leaves (more tropical look), 24,230 tris
  SM_BroadTree_B_ez.gltf      -> SM_BroadTree_B  tall spreading/layered jungle canopy tree, 16 m, 21,044 tris
  SM_BroadTree_B_ash_ez.gltf  -> SM_BroadTree_B  alt with pinnate leaves, 21,044 tris
  SM_BroadTree_C_ez.gltf      -> SM_BroadTree_C  small garden tree, 6 m, 12,750 tris
  SM_PineTree_A_ez.gltf       -> SM_PineTree_A   conifer, 14 m, 19,392 tris
  SM_DeadTree_A_ez.gltf       -> SM_DeadTree_A   leafless gnarled grey tree, 9 m, 3,910 tris
  SM_Bush_A_ez.gltf           -> SM_Bush_A       round bush, 1.6 m, 6,760 tris
  SM_Bush_B_ez.gltf           -> SM_Bush_B       wide low bush, 1.0 m, 4,160 tris
  (Each glTF: Y-up, metres, origin at trunk base; 2 materials: MI_EzBark_<type> (baseColor + OpenGL normal + ORM
   [R=AO,G=roughness,B=metal 0]) and MI_EzLeaves_<type> (alpha MASK, two-sided). Heights were normalised by the generator.)

GENERATOR: @dgreenheck/ez-tree 1.1.0 by Daniel Greenheck - https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree , https://eztree.dev
  npm tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/@dgreenheck/ez-tree/-/ez-tree-1.1.0.tgz (downloaded 2026-10-28,
    sha1 b3426d04d536825e067eb6292c909824dc942ac3 = registry dist.shasum)
  three.js 0.169.0 (MIT) from https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.169.0.tgz used as runtime only.
  Ran headless in Node 22: generator/lib is ez-tree's src/lib with (a) '.js' import suffixes, (b) textures.js replaced
  by a stub (no image loading), (c) presets/index.js reading the JSON presets with fs. generator/gen.mjs (our code)
  walks Tree.branches / Tree.leaves arrays and writes glTF 2.0 (uint32 indices, bark UV repeat baked into UVs).
  Parameters for every tree: generator/final_cfg.json (preset + overrides + seed). Reproduce:
     node generator/gen.mjs generator/final_cfg.json <outdir>   (with three@0.169.0 in node_modules)
     python generator/prep_eztex.py <ez-tree/src/lib/assets> <outdir>/textures

LICENSES / EVIDENCE:
  * EZ-Tree code + bundled assets: MIT. Evidence: package.json "license": "MIT", "author": "Daniel Greenheck";
    LICENSE file (kept as generator/LICENSE_ez-tree_MIT.txt): "MIT License Copyright (c) 2024 Daniel Greenheck
    Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, ... to deal in the Software without restriction ...".
    The generated meshes are output of the tool (procedural geometry); keep the MIT notice with the generator files.
  * Leaf textures textures/{oak,ash,pine}_color.png: shipped in the MIT package (src/lib/assets/leaves/), no separate
    source stated -> covered by the package's MIT license (record notice above). prep_eztex.py re-saves them from
    palette PNG to RGBA PNG; pixels are identical to the package files (verified).
  * Bark textures (from src/lib/assets/bark/, README kept as textures/BARK_SOURCES_README.md):
      "Oak - https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_brown_02"     -> Poly Haven, CC0 1.0  (oak_color/normal/orm_1k)
      "Willow - https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_willow_02" -> Poly Haven, CC0 1.0  (willow_*; used for the dead tree)
      "Pine - https://www.texturecan.com/details/588/"  -> TextureCan, CC0 1.0  (pine_*; used for the pine)
    Poly Haven license quote (as recorded in raw.githubusercontent.com/2600th/web-ocean-3d/main/ASSET_LICENSES.md):
      "All assets on Poly Haven are licensed as CC0, which is the same as public domain ... without attribution or permission."
    TextureCan terms (https://www.texturecan.com/terms/ - blocked from this container), as quoted in
      raw.githubusercontent.com/McFredward/GloomhavenVR/main/unity/GloomhavenVR.Assets/Assets/Bundle/Environments/License.md:
      "All the PBR textures ... are under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universe License ... The textures are allowed to be
      redistributed together with your projects."  Also 117HD/RLHD textures/000_licenses.txt: "TextureCan. All textures on
      this site are licensed as CC0."
  * ORM PNGs were packed by us from the package's *_ao_1k.jpg + *_roughness_1k.jpg (prep_eztex.py).

TECH NOTES: all 9 files imported in Blender 5.2 without missing images; previews/ has Cycles renders.
  Leaf cards are double billboards (4 tris/leaf); leaf normals are the card normals - for nicer foliage shading in UE
  consider spherical (crown-centre) normals or a two-sided foliage shading model + subsurface. Leaf tint is applied
  as baseColorFactor (0xE8FFBF) - texture itself unchanged.
DATE: 2026-10-28

AUDIT (independent re-verification, 2026-10-28):
  - Re-downloaded ez-tree-1.1.0.tgz from registry.npmjs.org: package.json "license": "MIT", "author": "Daniel Greenheck";
    LICENSE identical to generator/LICENSE_ez-tree_MIT.txt; src/lib/assets/bark/README.md identical to
    textures/BARK_SOURCES_README.md (Oak = polyhaven bark_brown_02, Willow = polyhaven bark_willow_02, Pine = texturecan 588).
  - textures/*_color_1k.jpg and *_normal_1k.jpg byte-identical to the package; *_orm_1k.png exactly equal to
    merge(ao, roughness, 0) of the package maps; leaf PNGs pixel-identical. Only oak/willow/pine bark and oak/ash/pine
    leaves are referenced by the glTFs (birch/aspen not shipped).
  - generator/lib: branch/enums/rng/trellis.js identical to the package; index/options/tree/textures.js locally modified
    as described above.
  - Blender 5.2 bpy import: BroadTree_A(+ash) 24,230 | BroadTree_B(+ash) 21,044 | BroadTree_C 12,750 | PineTree_A 19,392 |
    DeadTree_A 3,910 | Bush_A 6,760 | Bush_B 4,160 tris; heights 12 / 16 / 6 / 14 / 9 / 1.6 / 1.0 m; all textures open.
